description: We are Midnight Crew—a powerful, fully-equipped, and multidisciplinary team ready to take on the NASA Space Apps 2026 challenge! We combine diverse technical skills, creative thinking, and a shared passion for space and innovation. Meet our members, explore our backgrounds, and see how we're turning bold ideas into reality."
summary:
We developed UT Orbital, an immersive 3D space simulation and gamified web platform that uniquely combines two distinct NASA challenges: Challenge 13: Space Mission Design Game and Challenge 14: Earth Information Jukebox. The platform features an interactive audio-visual module that translates live NASA telemetry—utilizing EONET and POWER APIs—into multi-sensory sonification across seven critical planetary metrics (wildfire frequencies, ocean symphonies, storm signals, atmospheric motion, land greening, ice memory, and global temperature fever charts).

By integrating an interactive progression system driven by "Science Gems," "Credits," and unlockable records, the platform transforms complex Earth science data into an engaging educational exploration game.

This is vital because combining mission design and data sonification into a gamified narrative bridges the gap between technical research and public awareness, fostering climate literacy and empowering users to intuitively connect with our planet's critical environmental shifts.
details:
UT Orbital is an immersive 3D space simulation and gamified web platform that uniquely integrates Challenge 13 (Space Mission Design Game) and Challenge 14 (Earth Information Jukebox). It features an interactive audio-visual module that translates live NASA telemetry—utilizing the NASA EONET API and NASA POWER API—into multi-sensory sonification across seven critical planetary metrics: wildfire frequencies, ocean symphonies, storm signals, atmospheric motion, land greening, ice memory, and global temperature fever charts. Users select records from a 3D rack, slide them onto a virtual turntable, and convert real-time satellite data into dynamic audio-frequency waves and interactive visualizers
As for benefits , It does have

•Accessibility: Translates complex, abstract satellite data into intuitive audio frequencies and 3D visualizers, making Earth science understandable for all audiences.

•Engagement through Gamification: Integrates a progression system driven by "Science Gems," "Credits," and unlockable records, turning data exploration into an engaging educational game.

•Real-Time Scientific Insight: Directly connects users with live, up-to-date telemetry straight from NASA archives.

The intended impact is so clear, the impact we want is to bridge the gap between technical scientific research and public awareness. By fostering climate literacy, the project empowers users—especially students and space enthusiasts—to intuitively grasp, connect with, and care about our planet's critical environmental shifts and climate anomalies.
We used the following tools to build this web:

•Languages: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+).

•APIs & Data Sources: NASA EONET API (Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker) and NASA POWER API (Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources).

•Core Web Technologies & Software: Web Audio API for real-time data sonification, HTML5 Canvas for 3D/2D visual rendering, and standard web development environments.

The project creatively merges space mission simulation with data sonification (turning raw science data into musical and harmonic audio signals). Instead of presenting dry charts, it uses a retro-futuristic "Jukebox" metaphor combined with gamification mechanics (Science Gems and unlockable records) to turn data analysis into an interactive, multi-sensory discovery experience.

Our team considered specific factors, this factors is:

•Scientific Accuracy: Ensuring that all sound frequencies and visual parameters correspond directly to real live telemetry values pulled from NASA endpoints.

•User Experience (UX/UI): Designing an intuitive, minimalist, and space-themed interface that accommodates seamless transitions between the 3D rack, turntable, and telemetry reports.

•Accessibility & Performance: Ensuring smooth execution across modern web browsers using lightweight HTML5 Canvas and Web Audio APIs without heavy external plugins.
